complete_gap_set.title: Gift of Strength Repeat does not impose Powerstorm repayment
complete_gap_set.candidate_question: A Spirit with no Energy remaining receives Gift of Strength and has already used an eligible cost-1 Power Card. May it use that card's Repeat without paying its cost again, or does Gift require the same repayment as Powerstorm?
minimum_required_facts: Gift of Strength imposes a card-cost eligibility limit but no additional Energy payment; the eligible Repeat is free. Powerstorm expressly requires repayment.

primary_source_refs.locator: CORE p19 Repeat: no universal repayment instruction

complete_gap_set.why_not_already_asked: Q40 asks deferred selection, Slow use, cards vs Innates and printed Elements. Q154 asks only Powerstorm repayment. Neither asks the free Gift of Strength case or distinguishes an eligibility ceiling from a payment cost.

complete_gap_set.title: Steady Regeneration permission, Growth limitation and per-disk price
complete_gap_set.candidate_question: When Green adds Presence via Growth, may it use destroyed disks while tracks still contain Presence? What is the price while Healthy versus Blighted? Does this special rule also let an ordinary Power Add Presence use destroyed disks?
minimum_required_facts: Green may optionally substitute destroyed disks in Growth placements, without needing empty tracks.
The substitution is free while Healthy; while Blighted pay 1 Energy per destroyed disk added.
The special permission is limited to Growth; an ordinary Power placement needs its own destroyed-Presence permission.

primary_source_refs.locator: 2017 original-core Green Power placements, including Overgrow in a Night
Ordinary destroyed Presence restriction and explicit exceptions

Q149 separately tests Blazing Renewal permission. This is not the unverified cost for selecting an entire Growth option in Q24.

complete_gap_set.title: Stored Drowned Invaders may be exchanged outside the Drowning moment
complete_gap_set.candidate_question: Ocean has previously Drowned Invaders stored on its panel. Between actions in a later Spirit Phase, may it exchange them for Energy to help pay for cards that turn, or must it wait for another Drowning or the Gain Energy step?
minimum_required_facts: The printed AT ANY TIME permission allows the exchange then; stored pieces need not be converted at the Drowning moment and conversion is not confined to normal Energy income.
complete_gap_set.why_not_already_asked: Q79 asks Fear timing, storage, conversion value, change and Dahan. Q143 asks printed versus modified Health. Neither asks when stored Invaders may be exchanged. The proposal avoids unresolved mid-action interruption questions.

complete_gap_set.title: Explicit any-Ocean Growth differs from coastal-land Growth
complete_gap_set.candidate_question: Ocean chooses its Growth option with two 'Add a Presence in any Ocean' instructions. May one disk be placed in the Ocean of a different island board where Ocean currently has no Presence, without measuring a numeric Range? How does that differ from its third option's Range-1 Coastal-land placement?
minimum_required_facts: The explicit any-Ocean placement can put Presence in any board Ocean, including a board without preexisting Ocean Presence, without a numeric Range-origin requirement.
The third option targets a Coastal land; the special Coastal-Wetland treatment is for Powers/Blight and does not turn that Growth placement into an Ocean placement.

primary_source_refs.region: All three Growth options and Ocean in Play

primary_source_refs.locator: FAQ .9v5kf36 third Growth option cannot treat Ocean as Coastal Wetland

complete_gap_set.title: Green always resolves its separate mandatory Growth addition
complete_gap_set.candidate_question: Green chooses its Reclaim-and-gain-Power Growth group. Does it also perform the separate ALWAYS Add Presence to Jungle/Wetland, or must it choose between that addition and Reclaim? May it take all the other optional groups too?
minimum_required_facts: The ALWAYS addition is in addition to the one selected optional group; take that addition and the Reclaim/gain group.
Select only one optional group, not all of them.
complete_gap_set.why_not_already_asked: Q74 presupposes the mandatory placement while asking ordering, so it only partly exposes this structure; it does not ask whether it is additional to the selected group. Q124 expressly stipulates no instruction permitting more than one choice. This proposal tests the actual exception in the native selection procedure, not a new Presence quantity.
complete_gap_set.novelty_status: source-only proposal; coordinator must adjudicate before adding; no reader information used
